events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. What's your favourite track from the legendary double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 in 2026.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true legend. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City. He would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie turns 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie 80
angles.copy: Thinking of David Bowie today, who would have turned 80. A true innovator and a legend whose influence is still felt everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves decades later.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page was born on January 9, 1944, and turns 83 today.

angles.name: Page 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are simply iconic.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rocker Rod Stewart was born on January 10, 1945, and celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still got that unmistakable voice and stage presence.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) was born on January 13, 1961, and celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic ska anthems.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer Paul Young was born on January 17, 1956, and celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Everytime You Go Away', a voice that defined the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946, and celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971, and celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary B 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still putting on a show after all these years.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean was born on January 21, 1950, and celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams, get into our cars... and onto our airwaves!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring legends like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and James Brown.

angles.name: Rock Hall First Class
angles.copy: 38 years since the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who was in that inaugural class, and who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen was born on January 27, 1972, and celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Gig Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles played their iconic rooftop concert! Imagine being a passer-by in London that day.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins was born on January 30, 1951, and celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake was born on January 31, 1981, and celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to solo hits, he's still bringing SexyBack.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason was born on February 2, 1940, and celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Sir David Jason 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Pop Larkin, a true icon of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: February 3, 1959, marks the tragic plane crash that killed rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Singer Rick Astley was born on February 6, 1966, and celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Rick Astley! Never gonna give him up, never gonna let him down, especially on his birthday.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born on February 6, 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82
angles.copy: Remembering Bob Marley today, who would have been 82. His music continues to spread peace, love, and good vibrations worldwide.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Carole King was born on February 9, 1942, and celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King 85
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the songwriting genius, Carole King! From 'Tapestry' to countless hits for others, a true musical force.

events.title: Anniversary of Whitney Houston's death
events.blurb: Vocal icon Whitney Houston passed away on February 11, 2012, at the age of 48. She would have been 64 in 2027.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston today, 15 years since her passing. Her voice was truly one in a million.

events.title: Anniversary of Take That's original split
events.blurb: Take That famously announced their split on February 13, 1996, leading to a national outpouring of grief from fans.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: 31 years ago today, the pop world was rocked as Take That announced their split. Who remembers where they were when they heard the news?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell was born on February 15, 1959, and celebrates his 68th birthday.

angles.name: Ali Campbell 68
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing those smooth reggae vibes.
